name: headerhue
description: Dynamic VS Code header color based on your project folder name.

enumDescriptions: Soft, light title bar that stays in the background.
Deep saturated title bar with white text.
headerHue.mode.description: Which color family to use for the title bar.

headerHue.intensity.markdownDescription: How strong the color is *within* the chosen `#headerHue.mode#`, from `0` (softest) to `100` (strongest). Title bar text stays readable at every value.
